verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਫਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਲੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: safal jana(n)m gur charan saran liv safal dhirasaT gur dharas aloieeaai ||

en.bdb: Human life is successful if spent in the refuge of the True Guru remembering the Supreme Being. Vision of the eyes is purposeful if it has the desire to see Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਨਨਿਧਿ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: safal surat gur sabadh sunat nit jihabaa safal gunanidh gun goieeaai ||

en.bdb: Their hearing power is fruitful who hear that creative sound of the True Guru all the time. That tongue is blessed if it keeps on uttering the virtues of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਹਸਤ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਸਫਲ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਦਛਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੋਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: safal hasat gur charan poojaa pranaam safal charan paradhachhanaa ko poieeaai ||

en.bdb: Hands are blessed if they serve the True Guru and keep on praying to Him at His feet. Those feet are blessed that keep moving circumambulating the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਮ ਸਫਲ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਮੋਈਐ ॥੪੯੯॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)gam safal saadh sa(n)gat sahaj ghar hiradhaa safal gurmat kai samoieeaai ||499||

en.bdb: Union with saintly congregation is blessed if it brings in a state of equipoise. The mind is blessed only when it imbibes the teachings of the True Guru.  (499)
